rows.name: Moving-average cross
rows.idea: Hold while the fast average is above the slow average.

rows.name: New-high breakout
rows.idea: Buy a close above the highest high of the last N bars; sell below the lowest low of a shorter window.

rows.name: RSI bounce
rows.idea: Buy when RSI is oversold; sell when it recovers.

rows.name: Band bounce
rows.idea: Buy below the lower Bollinger band; sell back at the average.

rows.name: Band breakout
rows.idea: Buy a close above the upper Bollinger band; sell back at the average.

rows.name: Momentum burst
rows.idea: Buy after a sharp rise over the last few bars; hold a fixed time.

rows.name: Sharp-drop rebound
rows.idea: Buy after a sharp fall over the last few bars; hold a fixed time.

rows.name: MACD
rows.idea: Hold while the MACD line is above its signal line.

rows.name: Losing-streak bounce
rows.idea: Buy after several down bars in a row; sell on the first up bar.

rows.name: Panic-volume rebound
rows.idea: Buy a falling bar on unusually heavy volume (forced selling); hold a fixed time.

rows.name: Volume breakout
rows.idea: Buy a strong up bar on unusually heavy volume; sell below a short average.

rows.name: Squeeze breakout
rows.idea: After an unusually quiet stretch, buy a close above the upper band; sell back at the average.

rows.name: Uptrend dip
rows.idea: In a long-term uptrend, buy a sharp short-term dip; sell on the bounce (Dip Buyer).

rows.name: Volatility-channel breakout
rows.idea: Buy a close above the average plus a multiple of the typical bar range; sell back at the average.

rows.name: Stochastic bounce
rows.idea: Buy when price sits near the bottom of its recent range; sell near the top.

rows.name: Weak-close bounce
rows.idea: Buy when a bar closes near its low; sell when a bar closes near its high.

rows.name: Time-of-day window
rows.idea: Hold only during a fixed window each day, starting at a chosen hour.

rows.name: Opening-range breakout
rows.idea: After the day's first bars set a range, buy a close above its high; sell at the end of the day.

rows.name: Early-move follow-through
rows.idea: If the day's first bars are up by enough, hold for the rest of the day.

rows.name: Yesterday's-drop rebound
rows.idea: If today opens well below yesterday's open, buy for the day; sell at the end of the day.

rows.name: Day-of-week
rows.idea: Hold only on one chosen day of the week.

rows.name: Fear-spike buyer
rows.idea: Buy when the VIX fear gauge jumps well above its average; sell when it settles back.

rows.name: Calm-market holder
rows.idea: Hold only while the VIX fear gauge is below a level.

rows.name: Fearful dips
rows.idea: Buy sharp dips only when the VIX is elevated; sell on the bounce.

rows.name: Fear term structure
rows.idea: Hold while near-term fear is below 3-month fear (markets calm about the short term).

rows.name: Credit-stress filter
rows.idea: Hold while high-yield bond prices are above their average (credit markets calm).
rows.data: High-yield bond prices (as a gauge only)

rows.name: Weak-dollar filter
rows.idea: Hold while the dollar is below its average.

rows.name: Falling-rates filter
rows.idea: Hold while the 10-year yield is below its average.

rows.name: Broad-uptrend filter
rows.idea: Hold while enough of the halal universe is above its own 50-day average.

rows.name: Breadth washout
rows.idea: Buy when almost nothing is in an uptrend (washed out); sell when breadth recovers.

rows.name: Gloomy-news buyer
rows.idea: Buy when the tone of stock-market news is unusually negative; sell when it normalizes.

rows.name: Improving-news holder
rows.idea: Hold while the short-term news tone is above its longer-term average.

rows.name: Stocks-versus-gold
rows.idea: Hold while the fund is outperforming gold (its ratio to gold is above average).

rows.name: Probability model, prices only
rows.idea: The same monthly-retrained model using price features only, as the comparison.

rows.name: Probability model + extra data
rows.idea: A model retrained monthly on prices plus the extra inputs estimates the chance of a gain over the next few days; buy when it's high enough.

rows.name: Extreme-fear buyer

rows.name: Greed follower
rows.idea: Hold only while the Fear & Greed index is above a level.

rows.name: Improving-mood holder
rows.idea: Hold while the Fear & Greed index is above its own average.
